Special Leave Petition (SLP) under Article 136 of the Constitution of India

A concise study note on one of the most extraordinary and discretionary remedies before the Supreme Court of India.

This infographic covers:

Constitutional basis under Article 136

• Nature and scope of SLP

Grounds and procedure

Screening/Committee mechanism

Limitation and important principles

Landmark judgments

• Key points for advocates and law students

SLP is not a regular appeal as of right-it is an exceptional constitutional remedy intended to prevent grave injustice.

comment: A key practical challenge in SLP matters is balancing access to justice with the Court’s limited discretionary bandwidth. The quality of pleadings and framing of substantial injustice often determines whether the matter crosses the initial threshold.
